title: Browser console errors detected
description:
The live homepage emitted browser errors.

Recommendation: Investigate the affected client-side dependency before changing unrelated code.
acceptance_criteria: The affected page loads without browser console errors.

title: Homepage lacks a meta description
description:
The rendered homepage has no meta description, which weakens link previews and search-result context.

Recommendation: Add a task-scoped meta description to public/index.html.
acceptance_criteria: The homepage provides a concise meta description.
The affected page loads without browser console errors.
